name: Exeggcute
description: Even though it appears to be eggs of some sort, it was discovered to be a life- form more like plant seeds.

moves.name: Hypnosis
moves.description: Hypnotic suggestion is used to make the foe fall into a deep sleep.

moves.name: Barrage
moves.description: Round objects are hurled at the foe to strike two to five times.

moves.name: Uproar
moves.description: The user attacks in an uproar that prevents sleep for two to five turns.

moves.name: Reflect
moves.description: A wall of light cuts damage from physical attacks for five turns.

moves.name: Leech Seed
moves.description: A seed is planted on the foe to steal some HP for the  user on every turn.

moves.name: Confusion
moves.description: A weak telekinetic attack that may also leave the foe confused.

moves.name: Stun Spore
moves.description: Paralyzing dust is scattered wildly. It may paralyze the foe.

moves.name: Poison Powder
moves.description: A cloud of toxic dust is scattered. It may poison the foe.

moves.name: Sleep Powder
moves.description: A sleep-inducing dust is scattered in high volume around a foe.

moves.name: Solar Beam
moves.description: A 2-turn move that blasts the foe with absorbed energy in the 2nd turn.

moves.name: Strength
moves.description: The foe is slugged at maximum power. Can also be used to move boulders.

moves.name: Solar Beam
moves.description: A 2-turn move that blasts the foe with absorbed energy in the 2nd turn.

moves.name: Toxic
moves.description: A move that badly poisons the foe. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

moves.name: Psychic
moves.description: A strong telekinetic attack. It may also lower the foe’s SP. DEF stat.

moves.name: Double Team
moves.description: The user creates illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

moves.name: Light Screen
moves.description: A wall of light cuts damage from SP. ATK attacks for five turns.

moves.name: Reflect
moves.description: A wall of light cuts damage from physical attacks for five turns.

moves.name: Flash
moves.description: A blast of light that cuts the foe’s accuracy. It also illuminates caves.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user sleeps for two turns to fully restore HP and heal any status problem.

moves.name: Thief
moves.description: An attack that may take the foe’s held item if the user isn’t holding one.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: Enables the user to evade all attacks. It may fail if used in succession.

moves.name: Sludge Bomb
moves.description: Filthy sludge is hurled at the foe. It may poison the target.

moves.name: Giga Drain
moves.description: A harsh attack that absorbs half the damage it inflicted to restore HP.

moves.name: Attract
moves.description: If it is the other gender, the foe is made infatuated and unlikely to attack.

moves.name: Return
moves.description: This attack move grows more powerful the more the user likes its TRAINER.

moves.name: Frustration
moves.description: This attack move grows more powerful the less the user likes its TRAINER.

moves.name: Hidden Power
moves.description: An attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the user.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.description: The sun blazes for five turns, powering up FIRE-type moves.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: An attack that is boosted if user is burned, poisoned, or paralyzed.

moves.name: Skill Swap
moves.description: The user employs its psychic power to swap abilities with the foe.

moves.name: Secret Power
moves.description: An attack that may have an additional effect that varies with the terrain.

moves.name: Bullet Seed
moves.description: The user shoots seeds at the foe. Two to five seeds are shot at once.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.description: A reckless, life- risking tackle that also hurts the user a little.

moves.name: Mimic
moves.description: The user copies the move last used by the foe for the rest of the battle.

moves.name: Dream Eater
moves.description: Absorbs half the damage it inflicted on a sleeping foe to restore HP.

moves.name: Explosion
moves.description: The user explodes to inflict terrible damage even while fainting itself.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user creates a decoy using one- quarter of its full HP.

moves.name: Reflect
moves.description: A wall of light cuts damage from physical attacks for five turns.

moves.name: Curse
moves.description: A move that works differently for the GHOST-type and all the other types.

moves.name: Synthesis
moves.description: Restores the user’s HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

moves.name: Moonlight
moves.description: Restores the user’s HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

moves.name: Psych Up
moves.description: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the foe.

moves.name: Ancient Power
moves.description: An ancient power is used to attack. It may also raise all the user’s stats.

moves.name: Ingrain
moves.description: The user lays roots that restore HP on every turn. It can’t switch out.
